name: L. T. Elevator Ltd
tagline: BSE-SME micro-cap elevator + automated-parking maker that ~doubled FY26 revenue and PAT, now stacking D2C (Ricardo) and overseas (DYPC Korea) deals -- but operating cash flow has been negative for three straight years and the equity-dilution cadence is intensifying
business_overview: L. T. Elevator (BSE SME, IPO Sept 2025 at Rs 78) makes passenger/goods/hospital/home elevators through the parent and mechanical car-parking systems through subsidiary Park Smart Solutions. It is expanding into premium D2C home elevators via the Ricardo Elevators acquisition (share-swap, ~2.5% dilution), into automated parking abroad via DYPC Inc. (Seoul), is building a West Bengal manufacturing facility (~2,500 elevators + ~8,000 parking spaces/yr, ~Rs 400 Cr peak revenue potential) and has started exporting to Malaysia.
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 111.7 Cr (+97% YoY); EBITDA ~Rs 27 Cr (24% OPM); PAT Rs 17.0 Cr (+91%); EPS Rs 8.88
Revenue Rs 64 Cr; OP Rs 16 Cr (25%); PAT Rs 11 Cr
NEGATIVE every year: FY24 -Rs 4 Cr, FY25 -Rs 17 Cr, FY26 -Rs 14.4 Cr (receivables ~1 yr of operating profit)
Borrowings only ~Rs 20 Cr; reserves Rs 6 -> 32 -> 73 Cr on repeated equity issuance
Company-stated 'Rs 250+ Cr executable' (May 2026); historically inconsistent across filings (24/100/244/250 Cr)
~63% -> 56.78% (Jul 2026), down 6.14 pts QoQ -- serial dilution (Ricardo swap, DYPC, Rs 50 Cr preferential, Aug-26 further 4.61 lakh-share preferential)
ROCE 30.4% / ROE 24.7% (optical -- not corroborated by cash); P/E ~37x
fundamentals_narrative: A genuine multi-year growth ramp -- revenue Rs 25->34->40->55->111 Cr FY22-FY26, PAT ~0->17 Cr -- in elevators (~7% global CAGR) + automated parking (~22% CAGR), with faster growth in the home-elevator and parking niches. Gross margin ~51%, EBITDA ~24%. But the deep read hardens three cautions rather than resolving them: (1) operating cash flow has been NEGATIVE all three years (FY26 -Rs 14.4 Cr) while reported PAT is celebrated -- receivables run about a full year of operating profit; (2) growth is acquisition- and equity-funded -- four M&A/fundraises in the 12 months since the Sep-2025 IPO (Park Smart, Ricardo, DYPC, a Rs 50 Cr preferential), promoter stake down to 56.8%; (3) SME reporting quality is weak (re-filed error-ridden results, an auditor the thread rates poorly, order-book figures that vary 10x across filings). No pre-2024 acquisition track record exists to judge integration ability.
technical_read: Not pulled -- thinly traded SME. Listed Rs 217 (Dec 2025) vs Rs 78 issue; ~Rs 329 (Aug-26).
sentiment_summary: High interest, cautiously positive. All 29 posts read. Bulls (rk1771, Satishwe) like the ~100% growth, the WB plant optionality, the Ricardo B2C entry and institutional participation in the raise. Sceptics flag: unexplained order-book jumps, Ricardo scaling from Rs 5.5 Cr FY25 revenue to a claimed Rs 6 Cr/month run-rate with a non-functional website, an unusual accounting presentation of share-capital inflows under investing cash flow, 'too many acquisitions funded by equity dilution', and general SME reporting sloppiness.
community_signal: Several trusted (elevated) users are engaged and constructive: raj1968 ('invested since last 4 months', defends the Ricardo rationale), Prdnt_investor (shared a positive Zen Nivesh deep-dive -- 'a microcap growing like a hormone-soused teenager'), Satishwe (detailed positive tracking, notes institutions buying), while radhakishandamani (elevated) flagged the order-book inconsistencies.

bse_notes: No formal corporate-action red flag, but repeated re-filing of results with 'glaring errors', inconsistent order-book disclosure across filings, and an unusual cash-flow classification of equity inflows are governance/quality concerns typical of a young SME.
bull_case: Multi-year revenue ramp (Rs 25 Cr FY22 -> Rs 111 Cr FY26) with FY26 topline and PAT both ~+100% YoY off a small base
Structural tailwind: global elevator ~7% CAGR, smart/automated parking ~22% CAGR; home-elevator and parking niches faster still
Multiple expansion vectors: Ricardo premium D2C brand, DYPC (Seoul) automated-parking tech + 12 patents + a US beachhead order, a 2.5x West Bengal plant (Q4 FY27), Malaysia/Australia exports
Institutions took the Rs 50 Cr preferential; several trusted VP users invested and tracking
Only indigenous Indian elevator OEM on modern German machinery, ~80% in-house; low debt (~Rs 20 Cr)
bear_case: Operating cash flow negative THREE years running (FY24 -Rs 4 Cr, FY25 -Rs 17 Cr, FY26 -Rs 14.4 Cr) -- reported PAT does not convert to cash; ~1 yr of profit stuck in receivables
Serial equity dilution: promoter stake 63% -> 56.8% in a year; four acquisitions/raises in 12 months post-IPO with no prior M&A track record ('not stress-tested')
SME governance/reporting: re-filed error-ridden results, auditor rated poorly by the thread, order book quoted as 24/100/244/250 Cr across documents
Thesis leans on a plant that is 6+ months from commissioning and a DYPC close still pending RBI ODI approval
Ricardo merger route formally abandoned Aug 2026, replaced by share-swap + a fresh preferential issue (more dilution); Rs 6 Cr/month Ricardo run-rate claim still unverified
verdict_headline: A genuinely doubling SME elevator + parking play with real sector tailwind and trusted-user backing -- but the deep read confirms three straight years of negative operating cash flow, an intensifying equity-dilution cadence and no management track record; conviction cut to Medium
verdict_reasoning: The growth inflection is real and multi-year (revenue +97%, PAT +91% in FY26; sector tailwind; multiple credible expansion vectors) -- keeps the '10x-in-2-3-years' growth-bucket fit on trajectory and optionality

Conviction lowered Medium-High -> Medium: filings confirmed the growth but also confirmed operating cash flow negative in FY24/FY25/FY26 (FY26 -Rs 14.4 Cr), receivables ~1 yr of operating profit, promoter stake down to 56.8% on serial dilution, and four M&A/fundraises in 12 months with zero prior acquisition track record

No formal red-flag tier -- sloppy SME reporting and a weak auditor are a live caution, not a settled HIGH CAUTION. Watch: H1 FY27 print (~Nov 2026) for the growth run-rate WITH cash flows tracking profit; DYPC close (by ~30 Sep 2026, pending RBI ODI); West Bengal commissioning (Q4 FY27)
